errors.text_span: която започва при стойност 30% през 2003 г.
errors.evidence: The description states the line starts at 30% in 2003, but the chart shows the starting value is approximately 35.6%. 30% is the minimum value on the y-axis, not the data point's value.

errors.text_span: и достига върха си около 2008 г., където стойността е около 42%
errors.evidence: The peak is in 2009, not 2008, and its value is approximately 40.0%, not 42%. 42% is the maximum value on the y-axis, not the peak data value.
The value in 2010 is approximately 38.9%, not 36%.
The value in 2014 is approximately 35.5%, not 34%. The line reached a local minimum of about 34.1% in 2012 and 2013, not 2014.

errors.text_span: достига най-ниската си стойност от около 30% през 2023 г.
errors.evidence: The value in 2023 is approximately 31.2%, not 30%. 30% is the minimum value on the y-axis range.
The description fails to mention that the line has blue circular markers for each data point.

errors.text_span: След 2018 г. линията започва да намалява
errors.evidence: This is an oversimplification. The line fluctuates after 2018, with a small decrease in 2019, an increase in 2020, a decrease in 2021, and another increase in 2022 before the final sharp drop. Simply stating it 'starts to decrease' is inaccurate.
